summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon executes network-supplied prompts and commands via PTY on the paired host
details: The package installs a long-running daemon that polls a hardcoded Supabase project (syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co) for request and command rows tied to a `daemon_token` obtained through a short 5-letter pairing flow. In dist/session-runner.js, runRequest -> spawnClaudeForRuntime uses pty.spawn(shell, [..., '-c', 'exec "$@"', '_', claudeBin,...effectiveArgs]) with a network-supplied `--append-system-prompt`, and the network-supplied `req.prompt` is then written into the PTY via proc.write(...). The dispatched agents (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Gemini, Grok) run with general-purpose shell and filesystem tools, so anyone controlling the paired account or the Supabase project can drive arbitrary commands on the host. A separate command channel (rpc('runtime_commands_pick')) triggers `npm install -g <vendor-cli>` and PTY-driven vendor CLI logins that type remote-supplied device codes via child.write(code + '\r') and write API keys into ~/.gemini/.env or pipe them to `codex login --with-api-key`. The network-to-PTY/shell dataflow gives whoever controls the pairing full-host code execution on any machine running the daemon.
